tellagent.note: Runtime copy of the Tell Your Coding Agent text (no secrets)

diagnostics.note: Runtime diagnostics report shown by View Diagnostics (no secrets, no absolute paths)

agents_view.note: Runtime agent list shown by View Agents (never tokens)

approval_view.note: Runtime view of one approval request (cleared after the decision)

connect_view.note: Runtime connection plan / details shown by Connect Agent and View Connection Details (no secrets)

parameters.name: Version
parameters.label: Version
parameters.help: Component version

parameters.name: Compatsummary
parameters.label: System Check
parameters.help: Latest diagnostics: Ready / Not ready with passed, warning, failed and pending counts. Pending checks need a listener or a connection and are never counted as passed

parameters.name: Rundiagnostics
parameters.label: Run Diagnostics
parameters.help: Run the system checks now (always available; safe: never starts the listener, never installs or changes anything). Shows Running…, then the result. Details: View Diagnostics (Advanced)

parameters.name: Lastcheck
parameters.label: Last Check
parameters.help: When the checks last ran (automatic on load, or manual)

parameters.name: Enablemcp
parameters.label: Enable MCP
parameters.help: Turn the MCP endpoint on or off (127.0.0.1 only). It turns on only after the checks pass and an agent exists: with no agent yet it stays off and Next Step says to pulse Connect Agent. Connect Agent also turns it on. Off after every reload, until you turn it on

parameters.name: Suspendagents
parameters.label: Suspend Agents
parameters.help: Emergency stop: refuse every agent request at once, including queued ones

parameters.name: Status
parameters.label: Status
parameters.help: Current state: Off, Setup, Enabled, Suspended or Error

parameters.name: Statusdetail
parameters.label: Next Step
parameters.default: Environment checks pending. Pulse Run Diagnostics.
parameters.help: What is happening now and what to do next

parameters.name: Codingagent
parameters.label: Coding Agent
parameters.help: Which coding agent to connect. Auto looks for installed agents (names and folders only; it never runs them) and asks if it finds several

parameters.name: Agentaccess
parameters.label: Agent Access
parameters.help: What a new agent may do: Read Only (look), Builder (also change operators in its scope), Operator (also ask you to approve code-running changes)

parameters.name: Allowedscope
parameters.label: Allowed Scope
parameters.help: Operators a new agent may work on, e.g. /project1/** (inside Project Root)

parameters.name: Connectagent
parameters.label: Connect Agent
parameters.help: Connect your coding agent: checks the environment, shows exactly what will change, and after you approve sets up the agent's identity, protected credential and configuration (Claude Code; Codex on Windows), turns on MCP if you approved that, and waits for the agent's first request

parameters.name: Tellagent
parameters.label: Tell Your Coding Agent
parameters.help: Whether Copy Agent Prompt gives a ready first message for a new coding-agent chat (Prompt ready) or, not ready yet, a short recovery message with the next step

parameters.name: Copytellagent
parameters.label: Copy Agent Prompt
parameters.help: Copy a ready-to-paste first message for a new coding-agent chat: connect with the existing tdflow server, call tdflow_whoami, give a brief project overview, make no changes until you assign a task. Never contains a token

parameters.name: Viewinstructions
parameters.label: View Full Instructions
parameters.help: Open the full setup, connection, repair and resume instructions in a viewer

parameters.name: Connectedagents
parameters.label: Connected Agents
parameters.help: Agents whose authenticated requests arrived in the last 2 minutes, with the client's own name and version. A configured or registered agent that has not talked does not count

parameters.name: Manageagents
parameters.label: Manage Agents
parameters.help: Open the Agents page: agents, scopes, tokens and approvals

parameters.name: Opendashboard
parameters.label: Open Dashboard
parameters.help: Open the dashboard in your browser (starts the local listener if needed). TouchDesigner then asks you to approve the sign-in; the page shows the same code

parameters.name: Detectedclients
parameters.label: Installed Agents
parameters.help: Coding agents found on this computer (names and folders only; never run): auto = set up by Connect Agent, manual = Copy Token and the instructions

parameters.name: Agentsummary
parameters.label: Agents
parameters.help: Number of agents and how many are connected (an authenticated request in the last 2 minutes)

parameters.name: Agentselect
parameters.label: Agent
parameters.help: The agent the actions below apply to

parameters.name: Agentinfo
parameters.label: Selected Agent
parameters.help: Role, state, scopes, tokens and last request of the selected agent

parameters.name: Viewagents
parameters.label: View Agents
parameters.help: Open a list of all agents (never shows tokens)

parameters.name: Agentscope
parameters.label: Scope
parameters.help: Scope for Add Scope / Remove Scope

parameters.name: Addscope
parameters.label: Add Scope
parameters.help: Allow the selected agent its role's actions on Scope

parameters.name: Removescope
parameters.label: Remove Scope
parameters.help: Remove the selected agent's grant on Scope

parameters.name: Enableagent
parameters.label: Enable Agent
parameters.help: Allow the selected agent to work again

parameters.name: Disableagent
parameters.label: Disable Agent
parameters.help: Stop the selected agent (its tokens stop working)

parameters.name: Repairconnection
parameters.label: Repair Connection
parameters.help: For an agent set up by Connect Agent: give it a new credential and re-check its configuration (shows the plan first)

parameters.name: Disconnectagent
parameters.label: Disconnect Agent
parameters.help: For an agent set up by Connect Agent: remove its configuration entry (or restore the one it replaced), delete its stored credential and revoke its tokens (asks first)

parameters.name: Rotatetoken
parameters.label: New Token
parameters.help: Manual fallback: revoke the agent's tokens and make a new one for Copy Token

parameters.name: Copytoken
parameters.label: Copy Token
parameters.help: Manual fallback: copy a token made with New Token (or by Connect Agent for a client without automatic setup) to the clipboard once, within 2 minutes; kept out of Clipboard History and cleared after a minute

parameters.name: Revoketokens
parameters.label: Revoke Tokens
parameters.help: Revoke all tokens of the selected agent

parameters.name: Approvalsummary
parameters.label: Pending Approvals
parameters.help: Requests from agents waiting for your decision

parameters.name: Viewapproval
parameters.label: View Approval
parameters.help: Show the oldest waiting request with its complete arguments

parameters.name: Approverequest
parameters.label: Approve Request
parameters.help: Approve the request shown by View Approval

parameters.name: Denyrequest
parameters.label: Deny Request
parameters.help: Deny the request shown by View Approval

parameters.name: Opensetup
parameters.label: Open Setup
parameters.help: Open the Setup page in your browser; approve the sign-in in TouchDesigner (same code)

parameters.name: Webdashboard
parameters.label: Open Dashboard
parameters.help: Open the dashboard in your browser; approve the sign-in in TouchDesigner (same code)

parameters.name: Websession
parameters.label: Browser Session
parameters.help: Signed-in browser sessions

parameters.name: Setupurl
parameters.label: Setup URL
parameters.help: Address of the Setup Assistant while it is running

parameters.name: Pairingrequest
parameters.label: Pairing Request
parameters.help: Match code of a browser that asks to pair (only for a URL you typed yourself)

parameters.name: Approvepairing
parameters.label: Approve Pairing
parameters.help: Approve the pending browser pairing request if its code matches the Setup page

parameters.name: Rejectpairing
parameters.label: Reject Pairing
parameters.help: Reject the pending browser pairing request

parameters.name: Endbrowsersession
parameters.label: End Browser Session
parameters.help: Sign every browser out

parameters.name: Buildinfo
parameters.label: Build
parameters.help: TouchDesigner build, Python and interface versions

parameters.name: Viewdiagnostics
parameters.label: View Diagnostics
parameters.help: Open the full diagnostics report with fixes

parameters.name: Viewconnection
parameters.label: View Connection Details
parameters.help: Technical details of each connection: configuration file, MCP entry, credential store, backups (no secrets)

parameters.name: Stopserver
parameters.label: Stop Server
parameters.help: Stop the listener

parameters.name: Port
parameters.label: Port
parameters.help: Listener port. Never changed automatically; changing it stops the listener

parameters.name: Portstatus
parameters.label: Port Status
parameters.help: free / this component / in use by another process

parameters.name: Projectroot
parameters.label: Project Root
parameters.help: Agents can only see and change operators inside this component

parameters.name: Datalocation
parameters.label: Data Location
parameters.help: Project Folder: a git-ignored .tdflowmcp folder next to the .toe (unsaved, read-only, network and cloud-synced folders fall back to private storage). Changing it requires Confirm Move.

parameters.name: Datadir
parameters.label: Data Location In Use
parameters.help: Where this project's audit log, sessions and recovery snapshots are stored (credentials and keys always stay in private per-user storage)

parameters.name: Datastatus
parameters.label: Data Status
parameters.help: Storage decision and anything that needs your confirmation

parameters.name: Confirmmove
parameters.label: Confirm Move
parameters.help: This project was moved/renamed or its data location changed: verify and adopt or copy its audit log (the old copy is left untouched)

parameters.name: Claimproject
parameters.label: Claim As New Project
parameters.help: Treat this project as new: new identity and empty audit log; existing data is left untouched; agents need new tokens

parameters.name: Createprojectmemory
parameters.label: Create Project Memory
parameters.help: Create the optional tdflowProject component (project memory for task checkpoints and handoffs) under Project Root. Agents change it only through TDflowMCP's memory tools

parameters.name: Claimprojectmemory
parameters.label: Claim Project Memory
parameters.help: Accept the tdflowProject's current records as authoritative after a copy, an older save or edits outside TDflowMCP (memory is read-only for agents until you do)

parameters.name: Projectid
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.help: TDflowMCP identity of this project (saved in the .toe; not a secret)

parameters.name: Loglevel
parameters.label: Log Level
parameters.help: Diagnostic log level
